## Limits of this run

- SciFact's abstracts and nine copies with 10% of words replaced, 51,830 memories written to one workarea, for latency at scale; qrels name the original copy only, so quality is not comparable to beir-scifact. k 100, no token budget.
- SciFact's abstracts and nine copies with 10% of words replaced, 51,830 memories written to one workarea, for latency at scale; qrels name the original copy only, so quality is not comparable to beir-scifact. k 100, no token budget. Asked with k 10, the size an agent asks, to measure latency at that k; recall@100 reads the shorter list.
